reference.text: A vote guardian for DAOs: a service that watches every live proposal, reads each wallet's past votes, and sends a plain-language nudge twenty-four hours before a vote closes.

pairs.later: A vote guardian for DAOs: a service that watches every live proposal, reads each wallet's past votes, and sends a plain-language nudge twenty-four hours before a vote closes.
A watchdog for DAO governance that tracks open proposals, studies how a wallet voted before, and reminds that wallet in simple words a day before voting ends.

Un gardien de vote pour les DAO : un service qui surveille chaque proposition active, lit les votes passés de chaque portefeuille, et envoie un rappel en langage simple vingt-quatre heures avant la clôture du scrutin.
A tool that follows live DAO proposals, checks the wallet's voting history, pings the voter in plain language 24 hours before the deadline, and also posts a recap thread after each vote.
A notification bot that tells DAO members when a new proposal opens and when it closes.
A weekly digest that explains what each DAO proposal means in plain language, with a chart of turnout so far.
An escrow vault that releases a grant to a DAO working group only after a milestone vote passes.
A marketplace where podcasters auction thirty-second sponsorship slots to local businesses.
A validator dashboard that charts missed blocks and fee income for a proof-of-stake network.
For each wallet, look at its voting record, keep an eye on every open DAO proposal, and send a simple heads-up one day before the poll shuts - a governance reminder service.

heldOut.later: A monthly governance digest with a turnout chart and one paragraph per proposal.
A weekly vote summary plus a table of how the largest wallets voted, nothing about patterns.
A weekly thread that explains each finished vote in plain language for newcomers.
